Direct Fraction replay verified both row pairs, common masses and base moments. Residuals at j=1 are (23/2,0,0,−15/4) and (0,0,0,−87/4); at j=2 they are (−6,0,0,14) and (−21,0,0,0). Their signs occur only at the corresponding bound, giving a nonpositive pairing with any feasible displacement.

The endpoint optimizers follow by maximizing w_jt−t². Independent Fraction arithmetic at all four bases reproduced the stated widths and midpoints, proved membership in each fiber, and verified the cap masses 1,3347/376,139/16,1/2, all below 9. The unique joint width maximum is at base 1.
